items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: this was the place where we had Louis Armstrong, Earl Hines, Zutty Singleton, May Alix, singer, Jazz Lips Richardson.

ctx.x: Was this considered vaudeville at this point --
No, it was cabaret. Not vaudeville, but they had variety acts there and this was the place where we had Louis Armstrong, Earl Hines, Zutty Singleton, May Alix, singer, Jazz Lips Richardson.
Were you considered a variety act, Buck and Bubbles?
